text:
was in Chiang Mai for 2 weeks on a trip through SEA. I had dislocated my shoulder in Koh Phangan 5 weeks earlier and this is where I was recommended to continue my treatment.

I found the clinic to be very clean and professional, the staff very nice and spoke excellent English. They have all the expensive equipment and knowledge to use it correctly

5-Stars
The new clinic opening promotion is very good. The place is spacious, lots of parking, and the staff provides good advice.
Spacious place, convenient parking, friendly service.
